MasulloGRH.classCharacter_mk.{u_1} (K : Type u_1) [Field K] [NumberField K] (χ : UnitaryHeckeCharacter K)
  (a : HeckeIdeles K) : (classCharacter K χ) ↑a = χ.character a
'MasulloGRH.classCharacter_mk' depends on axioms: [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]
MasulloGRH.genuineHecke_convolution_eigencharacter.{u_1} (K : Type u_1) [Field K] [NumberField K]
  (μ : Measure (HeckeIdeleClasses K)) (φ : HeckeIdeleClasses K → ℂ) (χ : UnitaryHeckeCharacter K)
  (hφ : Integrable (fun g => φ g * ↑((classCharacter K χ) g)) μ) (x : HeckeIdeleClasses K) :
  Integrable (fun g => φ g * ↑((classCharacter K χ) (g⁻¹ * x)⁻¹)) μ ∧
    ideleClassConvolution K μ φ (fun y => ↑((classCharacter K χ) y⁻¹)) x =
      heckeMellin K μ φ χ * ↑((classCharacter K χ) x⁻¹)

MasulloGRH.genuine_firstJet_action.{u_1} (K : Type u_1) [Field K] [NumberField K] (μ : Measure (HeckeIdeleClasses K))
  [IsFiniteMeasureOnCompacts μ] (φ : HeckeIdeleClasses K → ℂ) (hφ : Continuous φ) (hcφ : HasCompactSupport φ)
  (χ : HeckeQuasicharacter K) (ℓ : HeckeIdeleClasses K → ℂ) (hℓ : Continuous ℓ)
  (htranslate : ∀ (g x : HeckeIdeleClasses K), ℓ (g⁻¹ * x) = ℓ x - ℓ g) (x : HeckeIdeleClasses K) :
  Integrable (fun g => φ g * (↑((quasiClassCharacter K χ) (g⁻¹ * x)⁻¹) * ℓ (g⁻¹ * x))) μ ∧
    ideleClassConvolution K μ φ (fun y => ↑((quasiClassCharacter K χ) y⁻¹) * ℓ y) x =
      quasiHeckeMellin K μ φ χ * (↑((quasiClassCharacter K χ) x⁻¹) * ℓ x) -
        jetMoment K μ φ χ ℓ 1 * ↑((quasiClassCharacter K χ) x⁻¹)

MasulloGRH.genuine_allJets_action.{u_1} (K : Type u_1) [Field K] [NumberField K] (μ : Measure (HeckeIdeleClasses K))
  [IsFiniteMeasureOnCompacts μ] (φ : HeckeIdeleClasses K → ℂ) (hφ : Continuous φ) (hcφ : HasCompactSupport φ)
  (χ : HeckeQuasicharacter K) (ℓ : HeckeIdeleClasses K → ℂ) (hℓ : Continuous ℓ)
  (htranslate : ∀ (g x : HeckeIdeleClasses K), ℓ (g⁻¹ * x) = ℓ x - ℓ g) (m : ℕ) (x : HeckeIdeleClasses K) :
  Integrable (fun g => φ g * (↑((quasiClassCharacter K χ) (g⁻¹ * x)⁻¹) * ℓ (g⁻¹ * x) ^ m)) μ ∧
    ideleClassConvolution K μ φ (fun y => ↑((quasiClassCharacter K χ) y⁻¹) * ℓ y ^ m) x =
      ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (m + 1),
        jetMoment K μ φ χ ℓ j * (↑((quasiClassCharacter K χ) x⁻¹) * ((-1) ^ j * ℓ x ^ (m - j) * ↑(m.choose j)))

    ideleClassKernelConvolution K μ φ (fun y => ↑((quasiClassCharacter K χ) y⁻¹) * ℓ y ^ m) x =
      ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (m + 1),
        jetMoment K μ φ χ ℓ j * (↑((quasiClassCharacter K χ) x⁻¹) * ((-1) ^ j * ℓ x ^ (m - j) * ↑(m.choose j)))

MasulloGRH.genuine_jetMoment_norm_bound.{u_1} (K : Type u_1) [Field K] [NumberField K]
  (μ : Measure (HeckeIdeleClasses K)) [IsFiniteMeasureOnCompacts μ] (φ : HeckeIdeleClasses K → ℂ) (hφ : Continuous φ)
  (hcφ : HasCompactSupport φ) (χ : HeckeQuasicharacter K) (ℓ : HeckeIdeleClasses K → ℂ) (hℓ : Continuous ℓ) (R : ℝ)
  (hbound : ∀ (g : HeckeIdeleClasses K), φ g ≠ 0 → ‖ℓ g‖ ≤ R) (j : ℕ) :
